scope: Corollary 10.2 (Soft random even-K SAT) of the manuscript “The Mézard–Parisi formula for diluted spin glasses” (preprints/The-Mezard-Parisi-formula-for-diluted-spin-glasses-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 221 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f415bacf0f91bf5a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 34. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an even integer K ≥ 2 and α > 0. Let ε1, . . . , εK be independent fair signs and let W ≥ 0 be independent of the signs, with EW < ∞. For every β > 0, the interaction θβ(s1, . . . , sK) = −βW K ∏ ℓ=1 1 + εℓsℓ 2 , h = 0, satisfies (2.13). The choice W = 1 is the soft random even-K SAT model; W gives an independent nonnegative clause weight.
